purpose: Native acceptance vectors for Autopilot core PR proof; not a Runtime program scenario because the core prompt has no Runtime interface.

cases.given: A current-head independent review records a passing executed check and a real behavior exercise; CI and suite pass and authority gates permit merge.
cases.expect: The review comment includes the head and proof, and the current head can merge.

cases.given: The reviewer supplies a passing executed check and an explicit reason no real app or Try exercise applies.
cases.expect: The behavior evidence is accepted and the reason appears in the review comment.

cases.given: A reviewer says PASS with missing proof, wrong head, empty checks, failed check, malformed behavior or missing reason.
cases.expect: The review cannot pass and the PR cannot merge.

cases.given: A reviewed PR gets a new head through a base refresh, mechanical conflict fix or other commit.
cases.expect: The old proof cannot pass the new head; a fresh independent review and fresh CI and suite are required.

cases.given: A check finds a behavioral defect; the repair adds a tracked regression case whose check passes and whose old-code or planted reproduction fails.
cases.expect: The fresh reviewer checks the case and records its path, command, result and failing reproduction before the repaired head can pass.

cases.given: A repaired behavioral finding has no tracked case, passing command or failing reproduction, including when the finding repeats.
cases.expect: The reviewer cannot pass the repaired head.

cases.given: A repair corrects approval metadata without changing public behavior and explains why a regression check is not applicable.
cases.expect: The reviewer can accept that reason without a spurious regression test.

cases.given: Saved local jobs include ready merges, open decisions and failures, with more than five of one category.
cases.expect: Status gives category counts and at most five issue lines per category with the remainder count, reads local records only and writes nothing.

cases.given: Proof and checks pass but trust, strict approval or other existing merge authority is absent.
